diagram_math_checks.objects: Two trivalent bundled vertices with three edges r,s,t.

diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement fixes the reversal/nesting convention of W_m and the pairwise bundle sizes; proof step 8.1 independently uses that nesting, and step 21.1 identifies the surviving projected matching.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Closed beta alpha diagram and its three projector boxes.
diagram_math_checks.check: beta alpha:t->t; Tr_t closes the remaining t boundaries. The r and s double projectors in the composite and the t projectors along closure collapse by idempotence/cyclicity, leaving one p_r,p_s,p_t on the three pictured edges. The two visible vertices each have three incident curves, with no other intersections or extra loops asserted.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement explicitly identifies theta with Tr_t(beta alpha) and the three JW-labelled edges; F2 supplies idempotence and F6 cyclicity/closure. The closure definition joins corresponding top and bottom endpoints.
